noise_statement: E_R, all 175 universes and all 10 laterals share estimator seed 42 (declaration section 4), so the training-noise term is not separable from these records. With b = b_bar + n (b_bar the seed average, E[n] = 0), E_seed[b b^T] = b_bar b_bar^T + Cov_seed(b), so the raw M is, in expectation over training seeds, at least the seed-averaged term. Any one realization (this one, at seed 42) can fall on either side. D11's X03 (seed SD of six Stage C universes' shifts, median 1.24-1.33 sigma_ML) is the only measurement of this noise; it is cited, not used.
